description: Ask the user a question with structured choices when this workflow is running on a cloud agent and no live UI session is attached. Requires workflowExecutionId. Do not call from a local IDE chat or when CHIMPHANDS_UI_ATTACHED is set — ask in the conversation instead. Put the recommended choice first. Notifies the automation's humans by email/Slack, or fans out to a live ChimpHands session when one is attached. One open question per execution.
name: ask-user-question-async
title: Ask User Question Async
